title: Fingerprinting the emissions of volatile organic compounds emitted from the cooking of oils, herbs, and spices
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,244-261
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00579A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ashish Kumar, Catherine O'Leary, Ruth Winkless, Matthew Thompson, Helen L. Davies, Marvin Shaw, Stephen J. Andrews, Nicola Carslaw, Terry J. Dillon
Real-time measurements of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) reveal the chemical fingerprints of cooking oils, herbs, and spices, offering insights into their impact on indoor air quality and pollutant exposure.
